content: {"episode_id":"ep-05045","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for episode ep-05045. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) accompanied by a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9) and known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). Per that note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring. We request reconsideration of the $722.52 balance on the basis of this documented indication."}
